definition.text: Scabby; itch. (1.) One of David’s warriors (2 Sam. 23:38), an Ithrite. (2.) A hill near Jerusalem (Jer. 31:39), probably the hill of lepers, and consequently a place outside the boundary of the city.

lemmas.gloss: Gareb, the name of an Israelite, also of a hill near Jer
a Jithrite or descendant of Jether
Ira, the name of three Israelites
